text:
clara (Design): tiny copy pass — empty state CTA in Routes list reads 'Create route' but the tooltip helper says 'Create a route to start directing traffic.' Feels formal. want concise microcopy that guides first-time users to pin a model and shows example route name.
pat (PM): yep, also want to hint at default model behavior: e.g. 'Routes default to org model unless pinned.' but keep it out of tooltip length.
dev (Eng): we should avoid parentheses and long dashes; keep tooltip < 80 chars so it doesn't wrap in narrow sidebar.
rachel (A11y): screen readers will read tooltips; prefer full sentence and avoid starting with verb fragments. include aria-describedby on button.
i18n-bot: note: keep 'pin' as a translatable token with context: 'pin = bind a model to route'.
clara (Design): proposing three short variants:
1) "Create a route to direct traffic (e.g. billing-invoice)"
2) "Create a route  try: billing-invoice"
3) "No routes yet. Create one to pin a model."
dev (Eng): 1 might wrap because of parenthesis. 2 uses nonstandard punctuation which could confuse SRs. 3 is clear and less likely to break. also include example inside modal, not tooltip.
pat (PM): agree on 3. modal helper can have the example name. keep tooltip copy: 'No routes yet. Create one to pin a model.'
rachel (A11y): tweak: 'No routes yet. Create one to pin a model.' is good; add aria-live politely when a route is created.
clara (Design): final: tooltip = 'No routes yet. Create one to pin a model.' modal helper = 'Try: billing-invoice' dev will add aria labels and i18n token.
dev (Eng): I'll implement with maxWidth=300 and ensure example is only in modal. will add tests for tooltip wrapping.
pat (PM): adding to release notes: clearer empty state tooltip for Routes list.
clara (Design): thanks team :sparkles:
